name: shape-gyroscope
title: Gyroscope Rotation
description: Hai vòng tròn vuông góc quanh một lõi xoay một vòng quanh trục dọc trong khi nghiêng lên 55° rồi về.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio gyroscope, written here): Two rings (r 58 and 44 px, strokes 4 and 3 px; the inner one perpendicular to the outer) around a 10 px core: the assembly turns rotateY 0 → 360° (sine.inOut) while rotateX goes 0 → 55° → 0 (sine each half), 1100 ms, perspective 360 px; back halves at 30 % opacity behind the core; a marker dot on the outer ring (front half only). Params: duration (1.1 s) · rings (58 / 44 px) · tilt (55°) · perspective (360 px).
